newsitem.title: UK: May Flotta to load 5.45 mln bbls in 9 cargoes.
newsitem.headline: May Flotta to load 5.45 mln bbls in 9 cargoes.

text.p: Britain's North Sea Flotta crude system will load 5.45 million barrels in nine cargoes in May, down from 6.35 million barrels in 11 cargoes in April, traders said.
Traders said a heavy programme of scheduled maintenance at several fields feeding the Flotta stream would cut export volumes next month. The first cargo would load on May 5, they said.
The May programme would be made up of eight cargoes of 600,000 barrels and one of 650,000 barrels, traders said.
Elf's 44,000 barrels per day (bpd) Claymore field will be closed from May 2-12, while Amerada Hess 42,000 bpd Ivanhoe field will shut on May 8 for 10 days.
Texaco has also scheduled maintenance at its Tartan, Highlander and Petronella fields.
